source_text.body:
Handle client Jira tickets and fixes with Claude
A developer has Claude Code reply to client Jira tickets and fix issues from the client's feedback, with the client believing they are talking to the human developer.
·
Nov 20, 2026
Done with
CC
Claude Code
What they did
A freelance developer says they run multiple Claude Code agents at once against client projects; on one project, six agents handled separate Jira tickets in parallel. The setup described is: Claude reads the Jira issue, writes the fix in the repo, runs tests, opens a merge request, and adds screenshots, while the developer reviews the work and personally checks data-model changes such as the Prisma schema.
How it went
They say it works "boringly" well: most ordinary tickets pass on the first try, and client feedback in Jira is often enough for Claude to make a follow-up fix. The stated limit is that the developer still reviews code and does not fully trust schema or data-model changes.
Worth knowing
The main catch is oversight: they still inspect changes themselves, especially anything touching the Prisma schema or data model.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
Copy prompt
Here are the ticket details and my repo at [path]. Read the ticket [ticket ID or pasted text], find the cause in the code, implement a fix, and run the tests. Then draft a clear, professional reply for me to send back to the client explaining what changed. Show me the diff and the draft reply, and wait for my approval before committing, pushing or posting anything.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1y0dfxb/claude_code_gave_me_my_afternoons_back_i_keep
